Battery optimisation is on: Android may stop the gateway. Open Diagnostics to turn it off for this app.
Every message this phone has not started sending is handed back to the server, and the gateway stops. Messages already handed to the radio cannot be recalled.
This session: %1$d sent · %2$d failed\nOn phone: %3$d waiting · %4$d results to upload
\"Sent\" means Android handed the SMS to the network. Delivery is confirmed only when the network returns a delivery report.

Only to authorised test numbers configured on the dashboard (Settings).
Test SMS could not be sent: %1$s

Android limits how many SMS an app may send (often 30 per 30 minutes) and then asks for confirmation on this phone. On your own phone you can raise the limit from a PC with USB debugging:
adb shell settings put global sms_outgoing_check_max_count 1000
adb shell settings put global sms_outgoing_check_interval_ms 60000
Some manufacturers ignore this. Respect your carrier's fair-use terms.
